variants.title: Characteristics of a strain gauge
variants.sample: Foil strain gauge, 120 ohm, in a quarter bridge on a cantilever
variants.unknown: the gauge factor and the linearity
variants.note: Strain is set by loading the cantilever; the quarter bridge gives V = Vex GF e / (4 + 2 GF e). Gauge factor 2.0 is a typical datasheet value of a constantan foil gauge (illustrative).

variants.title: Characteristics of an LVDT
variants.sample: LVDT on a micrometer stage, plus or minus 5 mm
variants.unknown: the sensitivity and the linear range
variants.note: The output is linear near the centre and falls away towards the ends; the sensitivity is fitted over the central plus or minus 2 mm. 50 mV/mm is an illustrative datasheet value.

variants.title: Characteristics of a type K thermocouple
variants.sample: Type K thermocouple, cold junction in melting ice
variants.unknown: the mean sensitivity and the linearity from 0 to 100 C
variants.note: Almost linear; the mean Seebeck coefficient over 0-100 C is E(100) / 100 = 40.96 microvolt per kelvin (NIST ITS-90 table, from memory - verify).

source.title: NIST ITS-90 thermocouple tables, type K
